Gifted by Peaceoutskincare. As someone who has always been on the lookout for effective skincare solutions, the Peace Out Acne Serum has truly been a game-changer in my routine. This serum is formulated with 2% salicylic acid, niacinamide, and vitamin C, creating a powerful trifecta that targets acne and blemishes while also working to prevent new breakouts. One of the standout features of this serum is that it's fragrance-free and paraben-free, making it a gentle option for those with sensitive skin. The inclusion of zinc is a thoughtful addition, as it helps absorb natural oils and keeps pores decongested, which is crucial for maintaining clear skin. What I love most about this product is its dual action. Not only does it clear up existing acne, but it also brightens dark spots and evens out skin tone. The niacinamide and vitamin C work beautifully together to enhance the skin's overall appearance, leaving it looking brighter and more radiant. As a fan of Peace Out products, this serum has not disappointed. It has become a staple in my skincare arsenal, helping me keep acne in check while improving my skin's texture and tone. If you're looking for an effective, gentle, and multitasking serum, the Peace Out Acne Serum is definitely worth trying.

It seems they've taken previous feedback into account because I find the scent perfectly fine now. I've come across reviews mentioning a horrible smell, but this seems to be a new and improved version. As for the serum, it's fantastic! I'm not a fan of using acne cream spot treatments because they tend to get on my pillow, but this serum works great. So far, I'm really pleased with it.

The serum has a gel like texture which I like because my oily skin can absorb very easily. It's nice and smooth and it doesn't feel sticky or heavy. Has a herbal scent from the centella asiatica. That ingredient always worked great on my skin and I know that this serum will do the same, just need time. At first what I noticed was that my skin was a bit tighter but I knew that this is a good sign. It means that my skin isn't too oily and the serum worked. By now, using it for 10 days, I can see that the red spots are lighter and smaller. It helps me with my cystic acne and clogged pores. I'm keep using it.

It's so hard to find skincare that works for agneic skin, but this one seems to be working well for me. I've only been using about a week, but I feel like I see the results. Its very very smooth on the skin. The smell isn't too strong or chemical-y. I use this as a spot treatment as the last step of my skincare routine.

I'm always on the hunt for a product that helps with acne and I feel like I tried so many brands. This one has been it. It actually cleared my acne and my skin looks good. Usually my skin will dry out with other products, but not this one.

I absolutely love this serum!! I struggle with bad acne, and this has helped my acne so much in just a few days. I definitely recommend as you won't regret it. The packaging is super cute and a little goes along way!

I have been loving this Peace Out acne serum!! It has been helping my acne significantly and reducing my acne!! I love how it applies to my skin!! I received this product free from Peace Out skincare.

Really love how this serum looks on my skin! It feels really good once applied. I have not noticed a dramatic difference yet but I have only been using it for a couple days now. Package is super convenient and easy to use!

I've been using this product for a while now, and I've noticed a newfound radiance in my complexion. It has a delightful texture and scent. Incorporating this serum into my morning skincare routine after cleansing and toning is seamless, followed by moisturizer and sunscreen. It's truly a remarkable find!

I have oily skin which is very acne-prone and this serum is very effective! It works better and quicker than anything else I have tried. Helps my acne clear up, feels lightweight on the skin, and doesn't dry out my skin.

I was gifted this product but after trying it out for almost two weeks I can honestly say I see improvement in my breakouts! As someone with acne prone skin, this really helps to decrease the size of my breakouts overnight and also helps with the pain and inflammation associated with them! I am so happy I found this product and would definitely recommend.

I love this new serum! It cleared up my acne so quickly! It eliminated my blackheads and helped my pores! I absolutely will be adding this product to my skin routine! It is amazing! It is worth the purchase!

This Peace Out Acne Serum seriously works so well. I had two breakouts. I used it at nighttime. They were just about completely gone by the morning, which I've never had happen with any product. I could definitely feel this product on when I first put it on. I just dabbed a tiny amount on each area. It dried quickly. I think for me, since I have dry skin, I'd continue to do this as a nightly routine whenever I have breakouts. This is my first time ever using this brand. avis.titre: Does not irritate my sensitive skin!!
avis.texte: This product is lightweight and feels nice on my skin. I have sensitive skin so I was a bit worried that it would cause redness or any sort of irritation, but so far it has been working great! I definitely recommend this product!

I really appreciate this serum's lightweight, soothing, and gentle texture. It also absorbs really quickly and does not leave any residue on my skin after use. My skin is pretty sensitive, so I like that it is both silicone-free and fragrance-free, which really benefits my skin's texture. In addition to bumps in my skin's texture, I have significant scarring and discoloration that this serum has been helping with.

This salicylic acid and niacinamide serum is good; not irritating on my sensitive skin. I use it during morning; I have this pesky pimples around my mouth I am trying to get rid of since months. This serum along with pimple patch has definitely helped alot with acne and hyperpigmentation.
